_about: Models. LLM bytes come from params x the quant's bytes per parameter; KV per token is for the layers that keep one (hybrid models keep a fixed state in the rest). agent: per-step outcome rates for agentic work, the part that decides cost per finished task: p_valid (a usable tool call), p_progress (a valid step moves the task on), p_recover (after a bad step, the next one gets back on track). Those are first guesses from Joshua's reports (Nov 2026) and are what Fleet should measure. eci: Epoch Capabilities Index where Epoch lists the model, else null. 'candidate' marks a pick to verify before use.
